app.name: Busa VC Diligence
app.purpose: The desk's diligence cockpit: one read-only surface where the investment team sees targets in diligence, open Critical and High findings, overdue and blocked requests, each target's workstream progress and claims snapshot (verified vs unverified), and the next actions standing between a target and IC.

binding.note: Shipped inside the Busa VC Diligence template package, so no Space, node or Base id exists at authoring time. At runtime the app resolves the resources the package installed via the SDK's inspectProvisionedResources, keyed by the folder slug, the per-Base slugs and the AirApp resourceKey declared in app/js/config.js. It never provisions, repairs or writes: a missing resource is reported as setup-required.

rules: Read-only: the app requests only nodes.list, nodes.get, records.list, records.get and records.count; it declares no setup or write procedures and no Change Request procedures.
Diligence work happens in agent chat; changes reach the Bases through Change Requests proposed there — never from this cockpit, and the cockpit never contacts a target company or any third party.

Bounded reads: one page per Base per load at the configured readLimit (50), with a visible Load More for each Base that has a next cursor; headline counts come from records.count, not from the loaded page.
No credentials, no absolute Busabase URLs, no hostname-based runtime detection: the runtime is probed through the SDK helper against the relative __airapp/runtime path.

surfaces.reads: targets with stage in (screening, diligence, ic); findings with status = open and severity = critical; diligence-requests not in (reviewed, waived) whose due-date has passed
surfaces.shows: three headline counts — targets in diligence, open Critical findings, overdue requests — plus the target list, the findings wall and the overdue/blocked queue
surfaces.title: Overview

surfaces.reads: all loaded targets with their requests, findings, evidence and interviews joined by relation
surfaces.shows: company, stage, round, workstream progress, open findings by severity; selecting a row opens the target detail
surfaces.title: Targets

surfaces.reads: one target and its joined requests, evidence, findings and interviews
surfaces.shows: thesis, per-workstream request progress, top findings by severity, claims snapshot (evidence with its verification status), interview consistency, and next actions (blocked or overdue requests, open Critical/High findings)
surfaces.title: Target detail

surfaces.reads: findings with status = open, ordered by severity (critical first) then resolve-by date
surfaces.shows: finding, target, claim being tested, severity and what would resolve it
surfaces.title: Findings wall
